# TXRAS - BDA Accessibility Services of Texas

> Texas-based ADA and TAS compliance consulting firm providing accessibility inspections, plan reviews, and regulatory expertise for commercial, educational, and healthcare facilities.

TXRAS (BDA Accessibility Services of Texas) specializes in helping Texas organizations achieve and maintain ADA compliance and Texas Accessibility Standards (TAS) compliance. The firm offers comprehensive accessibility consulting services including site inspections, transition planning, and expert guidance on accessibility regulations.

## Key Topics

- ADA Compliance
- Texas Accessibility Standards (TAS)
- Registered Accessibility Specialist (RAS)
- Site Inspections
- Plan Reviews
- Accessibility Consulting
- Project Registration
- Transition Plans
- Commercial Projects
- Historic Renovations
- Dallas/Fort Worth Services
- TDLR Certification
- Accessibility Standards
- Compliance Documentation
